issue.title: test_kitchen_follow_copy_edit_and_media_for_each_supported_action is over the flake baseline with no bead, blocking check-full's last gate
issue.description:
`tests/pager/test_rendered_link_contract.py::test_kitchen_follow_copy_edit_and_media_for_each_supported_action`
is over the flake baseline with no bead, so `just check-full`'s final
`selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` gate fails for every landing agent that reaches it.

The node passes serially in isolation but fails in 9 recorded full-run records from
2026-09-08 across 4 commits, including one clean-tree (tree_dirty=False) record and four
runs in which it was the only failure. Its isolated call time is ~8.9s, which suggests it
sits near a wait/timeout budget with no headroom under full-lane load.

Fix the node's timing headroom (preferred), or add it to
tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt with this bead ID if it is judged acceptable.

task_type_fields.evidence:
FOUND BY the sase-yf.3 land agent while consuming `just check-full` monitor gnpxe55njpgk.
NOT caused by sase-yf/sase-yf.3 (star-triggered model alias completion): that change set
touches only src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/ model-completion rendering and its ACE tests, and
the failure reproduces byte-identically with the tree stashed clean (see below).

FAIL/PASS OBSERVATIONS
- Fails in 9 recorded full-run records, all on 2026-09-08, across 4 distinct commits and
  several workspaces: 18b0a91a2, 3f9c7b451, 478c79b02, a5e642c92.
- One of those records has tree_dirty=False (20260908T182214Z-3f9c7b451655, 3 failures
  total), so this is not dirty-tree source-audit breakage.
- In 4 of the 9 records the node was the ONLY failure in the run
  (20260908T185837Z / 192240Z / 195902Z / 200234Z, all at 478c79b02). A run whose sole
  failure is this node argues against generic parallel-lane contention cascade.
- Passes serially in isolation on the current tree:
  `.venv/bin/python -m pytest "tests/pager/test_rendered_link_contract.py::test_kitchen_follow_copy_edit_and_media_for_each_supported_action" -q -m ""`
  -> 1 passed in 11.93s, with the call itself taking 8.93s. That ~9s single-node call
  time is the likely mechanism: the node is close enough to a timeout/wait budget that it
  loses the margin under full-lane load.

WHY IT BLOCKS LANDINGS
`just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` is the last gate of `just check-full`, and the
node has no entry in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt, so the gate reports
"1 reproducible flake(s) exceed tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt ... Additions
require a filed bead; fix or file the node before landing." This fails every landing agent
that reaches the gate.

CLEAN-TREE REPRODUCTION
Ran `.venv/bin/python tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake` twice in workspace
sase_19 at master 986feca08: once with the sase-yf.3 change set applied and once with it
stashed via `git stash push -u`. Both exit 1 and both name exactly this one node, so the
gate failure is independent of the working tree.
